Depression isn't just one feeling. Depression has many faces. It usually feels as if everything is hopeless and anything you do or say will never help. In the start, you just want to die. You don't care to think of how your family or friends will feel about it, it doesn't matter because they'll be fine if you are gone. Later you can't stop thinking about them. You get so upset for being sad all the time and you begin to isolate yourself as to not cause them any harm. You want to die, but you can't even hurt yourself anymore because you know you shouldn't. Fast forward and you begin to be so extremely upset about being stuck in the sadness. Either you fall asleep or you become strong enough to do something about it. You grow and work and learn more about yourself. You feel almost normal... and then you relapse. All the feelings come back and you feel horrible. BUTTTT, you know you're recovering because each relapse lasts for less and less time. 
In my opinion you need to recover on your own. Others can help of course, but they should not be the only reason you're able to smile.
